image.subject: 民航局邀集地方政府代表舉辦遙控無人機管理業務工作會議

zh.title: 民航局召開無人機管理會議 盤點測試場域並公布註冊統計
zh.summary: 民航局召開無人機管理會議；全台註冊達42016架；核准10案物流試辦計畫
body: 交通部民用航空局於2026年8月11日召開115年度第一次縣市政府遙控無人機管理業務工作會議，首度說明無人機測試場域盤點與規劃，並針對違規取締及關鍵基礎設施禁飛宣導進行討論。
民航局統計，截至2026年6月底，全台遙控無人機總註冊架數達42,016架，專業操作證發放23,518張，由17,343人持有。其中專業操作證持有數量前三名縣市分別為高雄市、臺中市及新北市。
此外，全台已有895家具活動申請資格之有效法人，累計核准活動案件達31,613件，以空拍攝影占84.75%最多。在無人機物流載貨方面，民航局累計核准10案試辦計畫，其中3案持續試營運，用於偏遠地區物資及醫療用品運送。

en.title: Taiwan CAA Holds Drone Management Meeting and Discloses Registration Data
en.summary: Taiwan CAA held drone management meeting; drone registrations reached 42,016; 10 logistics trials approved
body: Taiwan's Civil Aeronautics Administration (CAA) convened the first local government drone management working meeting of 2026 on August 11, presenting plans for drone testing sites while discussing enforcement practices and flying restrictions around critical infrastructure.

According to the CAA, Taiwan had 42,016 registered drones as of late June 2026. Professional operator certificates reached 23,518 across 17,343 holders, with Kaohsiung City, Taichung City, and New Taipei City accounting for the highest number of certificate holders.

The agency also noted 895 qualified legal entities and 31,613 approved activity applications, led by aerial photography at 84.75 percent. In drone logistics, the CAA has approved 10 pilot projects, with three remaining in active trial operation for remote delivery of daily necessities and medical supplies.
